en.title: Coronation of the Ice Flower, Garden of Oblivion
en.premise: In a city sustained by a cruel harmony of stolen memories, a former Knight Commander vows to shatter the 'Mirror of Truth'—the very foundation of the world—to reclaim what was stolen from his people. Yet, the Saint who guards the mirror believes that this accumulation of memories is the only ark capable of saving humanity from extinction. As two opposing truths collide on a fateful night, amidst the drifting fragments of lost lives, they must confront the true meaning of human dignity.

zh.title: 冰华加冕，忘却之庭
zh.premise: 在一座建立在掠夺记忆的残酷和谐之上的都市中，曾经的骑士团长为了夺回民众被夺走的记忆，誓要摧毁世界的根基——『真理之镜』。而作为之镜守护者的圣女则坚信，记忆的积聚才是拯救人类免于灭亡的唯一方舟。当正义与正义在某个夜晚激烈碰撞，在纷纷飘落的生命碎片之中，他们将面对关于人类尊严的终极拷问。
